title: Your account
guest_here: Playing as {{ name }} (guest) in this browser.
no_record: Play a daily puzzle to start your record.
public_profile: Your profile as others see it
guest_cta: Create an account to keep this guest's results and streak, and to play on other devices.
sign_in_cta: Sign in to see your streak on any device. You can also just play, as a guest.
name_hint: Your results count on the leaderboard under this name.

rename.hint: Your past results move to the new name. You can change it once every {{ days }} days.
rename.wait: You can change your username again from {{ date }}.

password_change.hint: At least 8 characters. Your other devices are signed out, this one stays signed in.

recovery.title: Recovery email
recovery.text: Optional. With a confirmed address you can reset your password if you forget it. We only write to it about your password and this address.
recovery.pending: Waiting for confirmation: {{ email }}. Open the link we mailed there within 24 hours.
recovery.sent: Check {{ email }} for the confirmation link.
recovery.remove_confirm: Enter your password to remove the address. Without one, a forgotten password can't be reset.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.text: Enter your username or your recovery email. If the account has a confirmed recovery email, we mail a link there to choose a new password. It works for one hour.
forgot.sent: If an account with a confirmed recovery email matches, the link is on its way. Have a look in your inbox, and in the spam folder too.
forgot.unavailable: This server can't send mail, so a forgotten password can't be reset here.
forgot.no_email: Without a recovery email a forgotten password can't be reset: we have no other way to tell it's you.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.text: The new password signs out every device of the account. This one is signed in with it.
reset.guest: The results of the guest playing in this browser move to the account, as when signing in.

confirm.title: Confirm your recovery email
confirm.text: Confirm the address this link was mailed to as the recovery email of your Hashi account.
confirm.done: {{ email }} is now the recovery email of your account.

mail.confirm_text: Open this link to confirm this address as the recovery email of your Hashi account:
mail.confirm_valid: The link works once, for 24 hours.
mail.reset_text: Open this link to choose a new password for your Hashi account:
mail.reset_valid: The link works once, for one hour. The new password signs out every device of the account.
mail.ignore: If this wasn't you, ignore this mail: nothing changes.
mail.changed_text: This address is no longer the recovery email of your Hashi account: another one took its place.
mail.removed_text: This address is no longer the recovery email of your Hashi account: it was removed.
mail.not_you: If this wasn't you, change your password on your account page and write to us:

delete.title: Delete account
delete.intro: Deletes your name, password, stamps and Dojo submissions for good. Your past times stay on old leaderboards without a name, so the other players keep their places.
delete.intro_guest: Deletes this guest and its stamps for good. Past times stay on old leaderboards without a name, so the other players keep their places.
delete.confirm: This can't be undone. Enter your password to confirm.

accept_rules: By creating an account you accept the community rules.

blocks.title: Blocked players
blocks.text: Their names are hidden from you on the leaderboards, in your groups and among your rivals.
blocks.none: You haven't blocked anyone. You can block a player on their profile.

feedback.title: Questions or problems?
feedback.text: Report a bug, suggest an idea or ask us anything. We read every message.
